title: hello event
description: Normative. The first line written by `python -m fpengine hello`; a `result` event follows. `protocol` is both the envelope field and the protocol version the helper speaks: a client refuses a helper whose value differs from the version it supports.

unicode_version.description: Unicode version of the character database fontTools.unicodedata uses (unicodedata2.unidata_version when installed, else unicodedata.unidata_version).

face_reader_version.description: fpengine.face.READER_VERSION (engine-metadata.md S3): changes whenever scanning the same bytes can give a different FaceRecord. Catalog caches key on it (WP-401).

capabilities.description: Feature ids this helper supports. v1 helpers send at least hello, scan, forge and forge.expect.
